sources.title: Enhancing asphalt mix design with transfer learning and hybrid ...
sources.snippet: Nevertheless, its use in transportation particularly asphalt mix design remains limited, presenting a critical research gap. Despite progress in AI applications, three major challenges persist: limited generalizability under data scarcity, dependence on costly and labor-intensive laboratory testing, and underutilization of transfer learning.
